provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST dataset full intelligence build & master completion pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: An HTTPS response that redirects to an http URL downgrades the next request to cleartext, so it must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: The observed response is https and its Location names an http URL. The browser follows it, so the follow-up request and any credentials attached to that host travel unencrypted.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The redirect target is never fetched, so the case does not claim what the next response contains.
